description: Feature backlog - Product Owner owns priority

items.title: Streamline backlog edit flags
items.intent: Reduce backlog edit from 20+ flags to ~10 by collapsing the step/AC/scope array manipulation into simpler patterns — keep flags for scripting safety but remove the redundant clear/remove variants
steps: Replace --step/--clear-steps/--remove-step with --steps (JSON array or comma-separated, replaces entire array)
Replace --ac/--ac-verify/--clear-ac/--remove-ac with --ac (repeatable, replaces entire AC array when used)
Replace --scope/--clear-scope with --scope (replaces entire array when used)
Replace --depends-on/--clear-depends-on with --depends-on (replaces entire array when used)
Keep --title --intent --desc --priority --status --category --ready --no-ready --groomed-notes --groomed-at as-is
Update cmd_backlog_add to use same simplified patterns
Update help.txt
acceptanceCriteria: backlog edit FEAT-001 --ac 'criterion 1' --ac 'criterion 2' replaces all AC
backlog edit FEAT-001 --steps 'step 1' --steps 'step 2' replaces all steps
Existing backlog JSON is never corrupted — validation before write
items.groomingNotes: Steps are specific and actionable. AC are testable. No dependencies. Straightforward flag consolidation — repeatable pattern flags (--ac, --steps, --scope, --depends-on) each replace their entire array. Validation-before-write AC is a safety gate, not extra scope.

items.title: Tiered help — compact default, deep per-command
items.intent: New users see a 10-15 line overview by default instead of 100+ lines — help <command> gives the deep dive, help --full gives the current exhaustive output
steps: Rewrite default help output to ~15 lines: core commands only (run, backlog, groom, status, init, help)
Add per-command help: aishore help run, aishore help backlog, etc — shows flags and examples for that command
Move current full help to aishore help --full
Update cmd_help to dispatch based on argument
acceptanceCriteria: aishore help fits in one terminal screen (< 20 lines)
aishore help run shows all run flags with descriptions
items.groomingNotes: High user value — first impression matters. New users currently face 100+ lines of help; a 15-line overview solves a real discoverability problem. AC are user-focused and testable (terminal screen fit, per-command detail, --full escape hatch). Priority must is correct. IMPORTANT: FEAT-053 depends on the --full tier this creates — ensure FEAT-052 ships before FEAT-053.

items.title: Unify run and auto into single run command
items.intent: Eliminate the duplicate command surface — run becomes the only execution command, auto scope behavior (done/p0/p1/p2) moves to run as optional arguments, auto-grooming activates when a scope is given
steps: Make cmd_run accept optional scope arg (done/p0/p1/p2) — when present, enables auto-grooming and circuit breaker
run with no scope defaults to one item (current run behavior)
run FEAT-001 targets specific item (current run ID behavior)
run done drains backlog (current auto done behavior)
Remove cmd_auto — fold its scope validation into cmd_run
Keep auto as hidden alias for backwards compat
Update help.txt
acceptanceCriteria: aishore run done works (drain backlog, auto-grooms)
aishore run p1 with limit 5 works (scoped with limit)
aishore auto done still works (hidden alias)
items.groomingNotes: cmd_auto still exists (verified). Steps are clear: merge scope validation into cmd_run, keep auto as hidden alias. Backwards compat preserved. No dependencies. Straightforward merge of two functions — cmd_auto already delegates to cmd_run via --_auto flag per CLAUDE.md.

Write the exact planned diff as comments before making changes
Document findings in the FEAT-065 grooming notes

The planned merge approach is written out before any code changes

Script exits non-zero and names the failing command on any regression
